headline: A 2011 executive order freezes US-held property of certain people tied to human rights abuses in Syria.
what_it_does: This order uses US sanctions powers to block, or freeze, property and assets of certain people connected to human rights abuses in Syria. Blocked property that is in the United States or controlled by Americans cannot be moved, sold, or used. People in the US generally may not do business with those targeted.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups linked to human rights abuses in Syria
who_it_affects.how: Their property and money under US control are frozen, and they are cut off from dealings with Americans.
They must not do business with sanctioned persons and must hold any of their assets they control.
